issue.title: Funqy QueryObjectReader not working in native image.

labels.name: upstream/closed
labels.description: The issue has been closed in the upstream repository

issue.body:
**Describe the bug**

Funqy QueryObjectReader not working in native image.

Note that jackson object reader works fine.

**Expected behavior**

```shell
curl -v "http://localhost:8080/greet?name=Matej" 
*   Trying ::1:8080...
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to localhost (::1) port 8080 (#0)
> GET /greet?name=Matej HTTP/1.1
> Host: localhost:8080
> User-Agent: curl/7.66.0
> Accept: */*
> 
* Mark bundle as not supporting multiuse
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< Content-Type: application/json
< content-length: 41
< 
* Connection #0 to host localhost left intact
{"name":"Matej","message":"Hello Matej!"}
```
